Economy.title: India’s balancing act to attract more investment from China, U.S. and boost trade
Economy.content: This balancing act has seen gradual and incremental relaxations in several long-held policies of the government — whether it has to do with FDI in e-commerce, allowing FDI from companies with Chinese ownership, or taking action against the dumping of goods in India by its trade partners.

Economy.title: Yen at 40-year low reveals Japan’s deepening monetary policy constraints
Economy.content: Driven by interest rate gaps, high energy import costs, and massive national debt, the Japanese yen has fallen to historic lows, limiting Tokyo's ability to raise rates to defend it.

Economy.title: Mint Explainer | What is fuelling the surge in GST collections?
Economy.content: GST collections have grown faster than nominal GDP in recent years, reflecting not only higher economic activity but also improvements in tax administration.

Economy.title: Will a repo rate pause make RBI fall behind the curve?

Economy.title: RBI set to hold rates on 5 Aug as global risks cloud outlook: Mint poll
Economy.content: Economists expect the RBI to keep the repo rate and policy stance unchanged, with markets watching its guidance on inflation, growth, the rupee and the timing of any future rate moves.
Economy.subject: Economy

Economy.title: Viksit Bharat 2047 under threat? World Bank says extreme heat costs South Asia 31 million jobs every year
